description: Instructional figure for lesson alg8-c2-s2-n10: horizontal-hatched closed half-plane and vertical-hatched radius-3 disk, with their crosshatched intersection. Source cell dimensions, integer phase, source labels and boundary inclusion are retained.

authoritativeText.text:
我们来讨论二元不等式组：
$\left\{\begin{aligned}y&\geqslant x,\\x^2+y^2&\leqslant9.\end{aligned}\right.$
这个不等式组的解集合是其中各不等式的解集合的交集。
我们来看看，以所讨论的不等式组的解为坐标的平面上点的集合是什么。

坐标满足不等式$y\geqslant x$的点的集合，是直线$y=x$上的点的集合与这条直线上方的开半平面上的点的集合的并集（图22中用水平细线表示）。
坐标满足不等式$x^2+y^2\leqslant9$的点的集合，是圆心在坐标原点、半径为3的圆形区域，包含内部和边界（图22中用铅直细线表示）。

一个点的坐标满足这个不等式组，当且仅当这个点属于这两个点集的交集。
图22中，两种细线重叠的区域就是这两个点集的交集。
这就是说，所讨论的不等式组给出一个包含内部和边界的半圆形区域。

例1：考察不等式组：
$\left\{\begin{aligned}x&\leqslant0,\\y&\geqslant0\end{aligned}\right.$
它给出第二象限及其在坐标轴上的边界，包含坐标原点（图23）。

例2：考察不等式组：
$\left\{\begin{aligned}y&\geqslant2x-3,\\y&\leqslant2x+2\end{aligned}\right.$
它给出以直线$y=2x-3$和$y=2x+2$为边界的带形区域，包含两条边界直线（图24）。

inventory.description: Exactly 12 columns by 12 rows; integer-phase lattice with centered origin and one-unit coarse cells. Source bounds [-6,6,6,-6], steps [1,1], offsets [0,0]; origin left/right/above/below [6,6,6,6].

Shared frame; solid axes, positive-end arrows, source x/y/0 labels, and 3 at the right circle intercept. Label sides are source requirements. Original labels and sides: 0: Immediately southeast of the axes intersection, inside the disk, below the x axis and right of the y axis. x: Near the positive x end, below the horizontal axis and right of its arrowhead. y: Near the positive y end, to the left of the vertical axis/arrow. 3: Just right of the circle's right-hand x-axis intercept, below the x axis.
Origin-centered radius-3 circle and the included solid line y=x in the same unit frame.

Horizontal hatch for the whole upper half-plane, vertical hatch for the whole disk, both in their overlap. Neither individual set may be replaced by only the overlap. Original shading: Horizontal, parallel to x axis; y>=x within the finite frame; above/left (northwest) side of the diagonal, including areas outside the disk. Vertical, parallel to y axis; Entire disk x^2+y^2<=9, including its below/right side outside y>=x. Horizontal plus vertical crosshatching; Disk intersected with y>=x; upper/left semicircular region. Its straight boundary is the included diagonal diameter and its curved boundary the included circle arc. No deliberate dashed boundary.
